rationale: Cuadrilla v2, rebuilt from the title-loss tape and the champion's published arithmetic. The aim war is settled (everyone EMA 1): v2 PLANTS in slots and bobs (the juke paid spread tax and dodged nothing), windows are bloom-disciplined (WINDOW_AUTO 360 default — arrive WITH the mag), the pass is gated at PASS_REACH (no forged-mag bait drags the crew), and SPAS bulls are only open while actually reloading. Card tweaks vs the orca mirror: per-tick bull clock (BULL_RETARGET 1 — convergence parity), and reload doctrine inverted after probes p1-p3: reload RARELY (at 5 rounds, not 9) and IMMEDIATELY in place — the v2 quiet-retreat donated a gun for 200 ticks per mag, while a fleeing reloader is a lure that pulls the orca wave through my crossfire. Probe record vs BLACKFISH: 7-2 (arena 61), 6-2 (arena 89); regressions 8-1 AKELA, 9-0 LERNA.
